title: 2020년 방한외래객 쇼핑관광 실태조사 보고서
definition: Foreign-visitor spend comparison between survey-reported total/payment-method spend and foreign credit-card spend; survey instrument explicitly distinguishes credit card/check card/cash/check/smartphone electronic money
sample_or_coverage: Foreign visitor survey comparison plus BC-card spending analysis
methodology: Survey-reported spend compared with card-derived estimates; payment method is separately asked in foreign visitor survey
limitations: Credit-card spend is a subset of total tourism spend; card provider coverage and survey concepts differ; do not equate card spend with total spend
license_or_access: KTO public report; official download page/access controls apply

title: 부산지역 관광산업 현황 관련 지역경제 보고서
definition: Foreign tourism spending is defined as tourism-industry payment amount using overseas-issued credit cards
sample_or_coverage: KTO DataLab foreign-card spending; Visa Master American Express JCB plus China UnionPay reflected
methodology: BOK analysis using KTO DataLab foreign credit-card expenditure and Busan tourism statistics
limitations: Captures card transactions in tourism industries, not cash or all electronic payments; merchant/industry classification and card acceptance shape observed total
license_or_access: Bank of Korea public research material

title: 부산지역 경제동향 2025.7
period: 2023-2025; May 2025 latest table in cited issue
definition: Tourism consumption growth separated by domestic/foreign consumer; foreign spend based on domestic total-card data according to note
sample_or_coverage: KTO DataLab; domestic Shinhan/BC and foreign domestic-total-card spend as reported in note
methodology: Monthly/annual tourism-consumption comparison by consumer group and category
limitations: Growth-rate table, not a transaction-level dataset; exact underlying raw-series extraction requires KTO DataLab download and metadata capture
license_or_access: Bank of Korea public monthly regional report
